“Authority is most authentic when it is exercised as service, when it looks beyond the immediate, and when it uses its power to promote the welfare of all.”

— Pope Leo XIV, Address to authorities, civil society and diplomatic corps, Buenos Aires (2026)

Via Vatican News, 8 November 2026
